en.headline: Education Bureau clears fee rises at private and DSS schools
en.dek: Average approved increases for this academic year are 4.75 per cent at private schools, 4.07 per cent at Direct Subsidy Scheme schools and 4 per cent at international schools.
body: The Education Bureau has approved tuition adjustments for the current academic year at private schools, Direct Subsidy Scheme schools and international schools, with average rises of 4.75 per cent, 4.07 per cent and 4 per cent respectively.

The bureau said that, as of the end of August, it had received applications from 53 private primary schools and 21 private secondary schools, together with 62 applications from international schools. Apart from the primary and secondary sections of one international school, whose application is still being processed, the rest have been approved. It said one private secondary school was cleared to raise fees by more than 10 per cent, while the other approved private-school increases were below 10 per cent. Approved international-school increases were all below 10 per cent.

On the Direct Subsidy Scheme side, applications from 12 primary schools and 37 secondary schools were all approved, at an average rise of 4.07 per cent. The bureau said one primary school and three secondary schools were allowed increases of between 4.21 and 10 per cent, and one secondary school was allowed a rise of more than 10 per cent.

The bureau also approved fee adjustments at 492 kindergartens offering full-day or long full-day classes, and at 17 half-day kindergartens. It said about 95 per cent of half-day kindergarten courses remain free. Parents of children in full-day or long full-day classes pay part of the extra cost, with a median instalment of about 1,130 dollars, 40 dollars higher than a year earlier. The bureau said overall kindergarten fees remained at a low level.

zh.headline: 教育局批准私校及直資校加學費 平均加幅介乎4%至4.75%
zh.dek: 本學年私校、直資學校及國際學校獲批的平均學費加幅，分別為4.75%、4.07%及4%。
body: 教育局已批准私校、直資學校及國際學校調整本學年學費，平均加幅分別為4.75%、4.07%及4%。
教育局表示，截至8月底，共接獲53間私立小學及21間私立中學的申請，另有62份來自國際學校的申請。除一間國際學校的中小學部申請仍在處理外，其餘均已獲批。當局指，一間私立中學獲准加幅逾10%，其餘私校獲批加幅均低於10%；國際學校獲批加幅亦全部低於10%。
直資學校方面，12間小學及37間中學的加費申請全部獲批，平均加幅為4.07%。教育局稱，其中一間小學及三間中學獲准加幅介乎4.21%至10%，另有一間中學獲准加逾10%。
當局亦批准492間提供全日制或長全日制課程的幼稚園，以及17間半日制幼稚園調整收費。教育局表示，約九成半日制幼稚園課程免費；全日制或長全日制課程的家長須支付部分額外費用，每期學費中位數約1,130元，較一年前增加40元。當局強調，整體幼稚園學費仍處於低水平。
